wiki.title: Susan Bernard (politician)
wiki.extract: Susan Y. Bernard is an American politician from Maine. Bernard, a Republican, was elected to the Maine Senate in 2024 (District 1). She is a resident of Aroostook and previously in the state house. In the Legislature, Bernard represents a largely rural district covering the northernmost part of the state, made up of the majority of the County of Aroostook, a county known for its potato cultivation.
